stem.text: The diagram shows three interactions that hold protein molecules in shape.

stem.alt: Three protein chain drawings, each with a labelled interaction: interaction 1 between N–H and O=C groups, interaction 2 between two S–S groups, and interaction 3 between NH3+ and COO− groups.

A.text: hydrogen bond; disulfide bond; hydrophobic interaction

B.text: hydrogen bond; covalent bond; ionic bond

C.text: hydrophobic interaction; ionic bond; hydrogen bond

D.text: ionic bond; disulfide bond; peptide bond
